data.narrative:
BlackSea Technologies is a platform-stage company in Defense & Security incubated by Razor's Edge Ventures. The valuation universe consists of 21 same-sector peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms, including top-tier comparables such as Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

The peer-median method is inapplicable here. While 21 Defense & Security companies exist in the comp universe, applying stage and valuation-tier filters yields fewer than three datapoints in any narrow peer subset. Using an all-sector median would introduce substantial noise and is therefore unsuitable for valuation support.

The absence of sufficient narrow-band comparables—same-stage peers with comparable scale—prevents reliable triangulation at this stage. A defensible valuation would require either (1) revenue or EBITDA multiples from the broader private peer set, if such data is accessible; (2) precedent transaction analysis within Defense & Security; or (3) explicit guidance from platform sponsors regarding follow-on capital expectations. Without quantitative input from these methods, no supported valuation range can be offered. Key uncertainties include the target's stage of development relative to named peers, technology differentiation, and customer traction—none of which are present in the available data.
